lesson.geometry: Demo mapping: blue hex collar slides down narrow white hex-foot peg; round blue collar slides down wide stepped white cylinder; white stems remain protruding. All units metres, left_base, table z=-.045. Capture4 cross-camera triangulation gives estimated heights hex .014, round .027, narrow peg .076, wide peg .080 (rough +/- .003); textureless white depth was unreliable. Initial XY: hex (.29092,.04760), round (.25439,-.11896), narrow (.15762,.08173). Wide moved about .010 during hex pickup and was remeasured in cap14 at (.3402,-.0367), top z=.0348. Exact pixels/ray residuals and estimates in measurements.json. Canonical down quaternion wxyz=(0,1,0,0). Closure widths hex .0534 / fraction .559; round .0522 / .5461. Hole/shaft diameter estimates are approximate, not precision fit measurements.
lesson.recipe: Actual executed entry point python3 scratch/operate.py COMMAND JSON_ARGS (Python3 stdlib; calls provided robot_client.py only). Each action logs and captures, then operator inspects images before next action. Exact target and feedback sequence in cycle_01_recipe.json and commands.jsonl; do not blind replay XY. Initial clear planned target (.29,.045,.15) succeeded. Hex approach (.291,.0476,.025), grasp z=-.031, close, lift .09, transfer (.1576,.0817,.09), descend .052,.030,-.020; open; withdraw .120. Round approach (.2544,-.119,.120) then .025, grasp -.022, close, lift .10, transfer freshly measured (.3402,-.0367,.10), descend .065,.032,-.008; open; withdraw .120 then home. Commands used canonical down rotation; no explicit joint targets, achieved joints in capture metadata. Held objects confirmed caps8/19, peg entry caps11/22, stable released assemblies caps14/25-27. Latest final cap27 and empty open gripper .9991 supported accepted success. Stage took 512.465s, 52 counted commands through reporting.
lesson.corrections: No failed assembly attempt, regrasp, or insertion retry. Two initial linear observation approaches failed IK without motion (caps2/3); mode=plan at (.29,.045,.15) worked, then linear moves worked. Wide white receiver shifted about 1cm during hex pickup/lift, likely open-finger contact; remained upright. Fresh cap14 measurement replaced old center before round insertion. Avoid this by checking complete open-finger clearance; narrower preshape is only an untested suggestion. Unreliable white depth replaced by cross-camera center triangulation. No right-side contact observed.
